title: Commercial Property Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant
Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

An established Yorkshire law firm is looking for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join its team in Barnsley.

This is an opportunity to support a varied commercial property caseload within a firm with more than 100 years of history. The team handles a broad range of work, including commercial sales and purchases, leases, new build matters, and investor and refinancing work.

What will you be doing?
- Providing day-to-day administrative and legal support to the commercial property team
- Assisting with commercial property sales and purchases
- Helping to prepare and organise legal documents and transaction paperwork
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, agents and other third parties
- Supporting the progression of matters and keeping files and case management systems up to date
- Managing correspondence, arranging meetings and maintaining accurate records

What are we looking for?
- Previous experience working in commercial property law is essential
- Experience in a legal assistant, secretary or paralegal role within a commercial property team
- Strong organisation and communication skills, with good attention to detail
- A confident and professional approach when dealing with clients and other contacts
- The ability to manage competing tasks and work well as part of a team

Applications from candidates without previous commercial property experience may not be suitable for this role.

Why apply?
- Join an established Yorkshire firm with more than a century of history
- Gain exposure to a varied range of commercial property matters
- Work in a firm that values a personal and approachable service
- Develop your experience within a specialist area of property law

If you have previous experience supporting commercial property matters and are interested in this opportunity in Barnsley, please get in touch to find out more.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Location: Barnsley
Job Type: Permanent
Career Progression: Full training and opportunity to qualify

Are you a law graduate or an aspiring legal professional looking to build a career in property law?

A growing specialist property law firm in Barnsley is looking to recruit a Conveyancing Assistant to join its expanding practice. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to gain practical legal experience, learn directly from an experienced legal professional and develop towards a more advanced role over time.

Previous conveyancing experience is welcome but not essential. The firm is happy to consider recent graduates and candidates with some relevant experience who have the right attitude, are keen to learn and want to build a long-term career in the legal sector.

The Role

Initially, the position will focus on supporting the day to day within the department. You will work closely with the firm's founder, receiving hands on training and guidance while developing your understanding of property law and the conveyancing process.

As your knowledge and confidence grow, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and progress into more advanced legal work, with the longer term possibility of working towards qualification.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Opening new files and completing initial administrative tasks
- Providing updates on matters and helping maintain clear communication
- Supporting the day-to-day administration of the property law practice
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring files are kept up to date
- Learning the firm's systems, processes and working methods
- Taking on additional duties and more advanced work as your experience develops

About You

The firm is open to applications from a range of backgrounds, including recent law graduates and candidates already working in legal administration or conveyancing.

You will ideally have:
- A law degree or some experience in a legal environment
- Strong organisational skills and good attention to detail
- Clear communication skills and a professional approach
- A willingness to learn and take direction from an experienced legal professional
- A positive attitude towards starting with administrative responsibilities and developing from there
- A genuine interest in building a long-term career in property law

Previous conveyancing experience is not essential. The firm is more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, commitment and potential to develop.

This is an opportunity to join a growing specialist property law practice where you can learn from the ground up, gain valuable hands-on experience and work towards developing a career in conveyancing.

If you are a recent graduate or an aspiring legal professional looking for a role with genuine development potential, apply today or contact Legal to find out more.

title: Debt Recovery Paralegal
description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Debt Recovery Paralegal to join the legal team of a well-established and growing organisation based in Sheffield.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a paralegal looking to build their experience within debt recovery, civil litigation and dispute resolution, working within a busy team and supporting a varied caseload of matters.
The successful candidate will be involved in the day-to-day progression of debt recovery cases, from initial review through to litigation and enforcement. You will work closely with clients, debtors, courts and other third parties, gaining valuable exposure to the full recovery process.
The role would suit someone who is organised, commercially minded and comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment, with a genuine interest in developing a career within debt recovery and litigation.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing and progressing a caseload of debt recovery matters in line with client requirements and internal procedures.
- Reviewing accounts and supporting documentation to assess the appropriate recovery strategy.
- Preparing and issuing pre-action correspondence and progressing matters through the relevant stages of the recovery process.
- Assisting with the preparation and issuing of County Court claims.
- Drafting and preparing basic court documentation, applications and correspondence.
- Monitoring defended matters and supporting the wider litigation team with case progression.
- Liaising with clients to provide updates on matters and discuss recovery options.
- Communicating with debtors and their representatives to negotiate repayment arrangements and resolve outstanding balances.
- Liaising with courts, enforcement agents and other third parties to progress cases.
- Assisting with enforcement activity following successful judgment.
- Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring all deadlines and follow-up actions are dealt with promptly.
- Using case management systems effectively to monitor caseloads, tasks and key dates.
- Supporting solicitors and senior members of the team on more complex or defended matters.
- Working towards individual and team targets while maintaining a high standard of client service and case management.

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will ideally have some previous experience within debt recovery, litigation, legal administration or a similar legal environment.
This role would also suit a recent law graduate or paralegal who is keen to develop practical experience within civil litigation and debt recovery.
You will be:
- Highly organised and able to manage a busy caseload.
- Confident communicating with clients, debtors and other stakeholders.
- Comfortable working to deadlines and managing competing priorities.
- Accurate and detail-focused when dealing with legal and financial documentation.
- Commercially aware with a practical approach to resolving matters.
- Confident using case management systems and Microsoft Office.
- Proactive, resilient and comfortable working within a high-volume environment.
- A team player who is keen to learn and develop their legal career.

Previous experience of debt recovery, County Court claims, civil litigation, enforcement or financial services would be advantageous but is not essential.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at an early stage of their legal career to gain hands-on experience across the full debt recovery life cycle.
You will work within an established legal team, gaining exposure to pre-action recovery, County Court proceedings, defended matters and enforcement while developing your understanding of civil procedure and litigation.
There is also scope to take on increased responsibility as your experience develops, making this an ideal role for someone looking to build a long-term career within debt recovery and litigation.

Benefits
- Competitive salary
- Bonus/commission opportunities
- Pension scheme
- Generous annual leave
- On-site or nearby parking
- Training and development opportunities
- Supportive working environment
- Career progression opportunities

About the Business

Our client is a well-established legal services business based in Sheffield, specialising in debt recovery and associated legal services.
The organisation works with a broad portfolio of commercial and financial services clients, providing tailored recovery solutions across a high-volume caseload.
The business has an established legal team dealing with matters from initial recovery through to litigation and enforcement, creating an excellent environment for a paralegal to develop practical experience and progress their career within the legal sector.

title: Family Legal Secretary
description:
Family Legal Secretary

Location: Barnsley, South Yorkshire

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Job Type: Permanent

Hours: Full time, Monday to Friday

A well-established law firm in Barnsley is looking to recruit an experienced Family Legal Secretary to join its busy Family Law team.

This is a great opportunity for a Legal Secretary, Family Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant with previous experience in Family Law who is looking to join a supportive and established team.

The Role

Working alongside experienced Family Solicitors, you will provide day to day secretarial and administrative support across a varied Family Law caseload.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing legal secretarial support to Family Solicitors.
- Preparing and formatting legal correspondence and documentation.
- Typing letters, statements, applications and other legal documents.
- Managing diaries, appointments and deadlines.
- Opening and maintaining client files.
- Liaising with Clients, Solicitors, Barristers, courts and other third parties.
- Handling incoming calls and emails and dealing with client queries professionally.
- Assisting with the administration of Family Law matters, including divorce, financial matters and private children work.
- Supporting Solicitors with general administrative tasks and case management.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant within Family Law.
- Good knowledge of Family Law terminology and procedures.
- Strong typing, administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to manage deadlines and prioritise a busy workload.
- A professional and client focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Experience within a Family Law department is preferred, although candidates with strong legal secretarial experience and an interest in Family Law will also be considered.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent Family Legal Secretary position in Barnsley.
- Established and supportive Family Law team.
- Varied workload and regular client contact.
- Opportunity to develop your legal secretarial experience.
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Friendly and professional working environment.

If you are an experienced Family Legal Secretary, Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Barnsley or South Yorkshire, this could be an excellent opportunity to join an established legal team.

Apply now or contact Dan Craddock at G2 Legal Recruitment for a confidential discussion about the role.

title: Trade Mark Paralegal
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Trade Mark Paralegal to join a highly regarded intellectual property practice within a leading international firm.

This firm has an established reputation for advising a diverse portfolio of clients on complex intellectual property matters, with a particularly strong presence in trade mark law.

Working with businesses across a variety of sectors, the team provides specialist advice on brand protection, development and portfolio management.

The firm offers you an excellent working environment, with a strong emphasis on collaboration, professional development and providing you with the opportunity to build a long-term career within intellectual property.

You will join an established and growing Trade Mark team based in Sheffield, providing support to Trade Mark Attorneys and specialist solicitors. The role will involve assisting with the management of a busy trade mark practice, supporting a varied client portfolio and helping to ensure the smooth running of day-to-day matters. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to begin a career in intellectual property, as well as candidates with previous experience in a similar position who are looking to further develop their expertise. There will be opportunities for direct client contact and ongoing development within a specialist IP environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide paralegal and administrative support to the wider Trade Mark team.
- Assist with the day-to-day management of trade mark matters and client portfolios.
- Support Trade Mark Attorneys and solicitors with a range of trade mark prosecution activities.
- Assist with maintaining accurate client and matter records.
- Monitor deadlines and ensure key dates and actions are managed effectively.
- Liaise with clients and colleagues, providing professional and timely support.
- Assist with the preparation and processing of trade mark documentation.
- Manage competing priorities and ensure work is completed accurately and within required timescales.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the wider intellectual property practice to deliver an efficient service to clients.

Skills and Experience
- A genuine interest in intellectual property, particularly trade mark law and brand protection.
- Previous experience within a trade mark or intellectual property environment would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Candidates new to the profession will be considered, provided they can demonstrate a genuine interest in developing a career within IP.
- A degree is preferred, either in law or another discipline.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage a busy workload and competing deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A proactive and enthusiastic approach, with a willingness to learn and develop specialist knowledge.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately under pressure.
- A professional and collaborative approach, with the confidence to communicate with clients and colleagues.
